title: Spending race — animated counters
description: Looping animation: two horizontal bars race from $0 with live dollar counters; the “spent opposing Platner” bar fills the frame while “spent supporting Platner” barely registers; ends on a $34 : $1 reveal.
alt_text: Animation: two bars grow from zero with live dollar counters. The red bar, labeled spent opposing Platner, races to $11,077,173 and fills the width; the green bar, labeled spent supporting Platner, stays tiny at $323,426. It ends revealing the ratio $34 to $1.
creator: Daniel Ismael Aguilar
usage_note: Data visualization compiled from public FEC filings and cited press reporting. Figures: $11,077,173 spent opposing Graham Platner vs. $323,426 supporting (FEC Schedule E, deduplicated, Oct 2025 – Jul 8, 2026).
accessibility_note: First frame is near-empty (bars at $0); pair with a static PNG where a meaningful preview frame is required.
